_doc: SINGLE SOURCE for the machinery terms a user-facing bearing must never leak (the product is orientation, not a workflow report). Both JS consumers (evals/static-gate.mjs, scripts/simulate-plugin.js) IMPORT this — no second copy to drift. The markdown reference fragment (skills/_generated/forbidden-terms.md) is GENERATED from it by scripts/generate-contracts.mjs, because a markdown skill cannot import JSON — the same generate-then-check pattern the webapp<->plugin contracts need. Run `node scripts/generate-contracts.mjs` to regenerate; CI runs it with --check to fail on drift.
